card.name: Linking words before malignancy terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "a" and "develop" right before malignancy, lymphoma or cancer in warnings about cancer risk with immune-suppressing drugs.

modes.label: "of" before malignancy
modes.description: The word "of" after risk, cases or increased risk, just before malignancy or lymphoma.
modes.example: 5.5 Malignancies An increased risk<< of>> malignancy with OCREVUS Z

modes.label: "a" or "develop" after patients who
modes.description: A word after "patients who develop" that leads into malignancy.
modes.example: patients who develop<< a>> malignancy, and patients who are current

card.writes: It pushes toward words about crime and criminal acts, which hints at a loose link to wrongdoing-type terms rather than a clear medical effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a cancer or lymphoma term in drug warnings.
